clips.title: The story
paras: At the Shrine of Eternal Flame, a Glowing Ember kindles the brazier for a shaman's trial. It comes from a Minor Manifestation of Fire on Durotar's crags.

A rising shaman drinks fire sapta to see the fiery spirits on the ridge near Telf Joolam. There, the initiate faces a Minor Manifestation of Fire. When the elemental falls, only a smoldering ember remains of its physical form. Raw elemental heat still pulses within it, carrying the living spark needed to awaken the sacred brazier at the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
